response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_press) AS avg_of_avg_pressratio, AVG(avg_size_per_min) AS avg_of_avg_size_per_min FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, st.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_press, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite) g

assumptions.assumption: Inner join to sites keeps only scans with a matching site code. Groups are (zoneref, typesite), and the final values are unweighted averages across groups.
A spanmin of 0 gives a NULL ratio (via NULLIF) instead of a division error, so that row is ignored in the size-per-minute average. Rows with NULL gbsize or spanmin are also ignored.
